name: Boyne Country RV Park & Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 45.1786,-84.9329: open sandy grass lot with scattered RV pads behind the office on M-75, jack-pine scrub to the north and ball fields east; no water in frame; not waterfront

name: Rifle River RV Resort & Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 44.0738,-84.0210: the lower loop's back-in pads ring the inside of a Rifle River bend west of the Melita Rd bridge, a strip of open grass between the pads and the bank, the river curving around the south and west sides; operator sells 'Riverfront Sites'; upper wooded loop north of the pond is not on the water; riverfront

name: CreationView Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 440 m and 800 m frames) at 42.0520,-84.3076: office, pool and drive off US-12, sites under continuous canopy to the north; a small pond by the office and an unnamed weedy lake ~300 m north beyond the woods, no visible sites on its shore; canopy can't confirm, defaults down; not waterfront
